biotools.summary: DNEA is an R package for fast and versatile data-driven network analysis of metabolomics data, enabling identification of differentially enriched metabolic modules. It builds upon the Filigree tool and provides a more flexible and powerful implementation for analyzing large metabolomics datasets.
